details:
I'm looking at https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/ios-bug-doesnt-allow-to-join-group-publics/voters as an example, and I'm seeing a lot of users without profile icons in that topic. The profile icon for these users is simply the first character of their display name.

When I look at a few VRChat profiles of these users, they have custom profile icons set in VRChat but the icons are missing on VRChat Feedback.

When an user logs in to VRChat Feedback directly at https://feedback.vrchat.com/ outside of in-client bug reporting, it seems an user gets a profile icon on VRChat Feedback from the login authorization automatically. The icon can't be changed manually from https://feedback.vrchat.com/settings, so this seems like a bug where setting the icon is skipped if the user submits an in-client bug report only and never logs into VRChat Feedback directly, or if their first topic on VRChat Feedback is an in-client bug report.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Check https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/ios-bug-doesnt-allow-to-join-group-publics to see a lot of merged in-client bug reports in this topic.

2. Check https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/ios-bug-doesnt-allow-to-join-group-publics/voters to see the list of voters as a summary, and a lot of missing profile icons.

3. Login to VRChat Feedback. Try changing your icon from https://feedback.vrchat.com/settings and see this is not plausible, because it uses icons from VRChat profiles (single sign-on). If you see changeable profile information on a new account, refresh this page and the data will be fetched from your VRChat profile and locked again.

4. Submit an in-client bug report from a new separate VRChat account with a custom profile icon, without logging into VRChat Feedback previously on that new account. If prompted to view your in-client bug report after submitting it, select "no".

Expected result: See / update an user's VRChat profile icon on VRChat Feedback when available, when an in-client bug report is submitted by a new VRChat Feedback user.

Actual result: The icon is not set on VRChat Feedback when an in-client bug report is submitted, and a fallback of the first alphabet of their display name is shown.
title: In-client bug reporting doesn't set a profile icon on VRChat Feedback (Canny)
